name: Photo-Synth 2 (VST3)
description: A free Windows VST3 instrument: play the colours of four photographs. Colour becomes pitch and timbre on the first photo, the second filters it, the third shapes the envelope, the fourth drives the effects. Virtual-analog voice with a ladder filter, a 16-voice pool, host MIDI and 24-bit export — all native C++ inside your DAW. Automotion draws the performance: shift-drag a line or ctrl-drag a circle onto a photo and the cursor walks it on its own, per pad, with speed, direction and travel shape. And the Brokild World Rack rides with every patch — twelve shared effect pedals from valve saturation to a Leslie and a step glitcher, plus six SPECTRA characters, Dark Drone among them, that reach into the voices themselves and possess the instrument.
note: Windows VST3 · build 260826.5 · free download · manual and developer kit included.
